title: Manager - IT Infrastructure
description:
**Job Profile**

* Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for the modernization and evolution of the data center IT infrastructure, incorporating emerging technologies such as cloud integration, Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI), Containerized Server environments, Software-Defined Networking (SDN), Advanced Automation, Stability, Uptime, and Operational Maintenance while Oversee the 24/7/365 operation of all data center facilities.
* Ensure that the data center system architecture is inherently scalable and flexible to support rapid business growth and new service deployments
* Ensure the data center IT infrastructure is in full compliance with all internal banking policies, external financial regulations, industry standards, and relevant certifications (PCIDSS, ISO 270001, etc.)
* Implement and manage a robust governance framework for all change management, configuration management, and access control processes within the data center.
* Design, maintain, and regularly test the High Availability architecture across all core data center components to guarantee continuous service delivery. Also Lead regular, mandatory DR drills and failover testing to ensure the bank's resilience and meet required Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO)

**Applicant’s Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Information Technology / Computer Science which recognized by the University Grants Commission.
* A minimum of 8+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing a large, mission-critical data center, preferably within the Banking or Financial Services sector.
* Certification in VMware or Nutanix is advantageous.
* Certification of CKA/REDHAT Open shift is advantageous.
* Certification in MSSE or RHCE is advantageous.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills capable of driving change and leading technical teams including Excellent Project Management Skills, Strong Problem-Solving Skills and timely result orientation.

title: Manager – Business Intelligence (FTC)
description:
**Company Overview**
Founded in 2014, and listed on the ASX since 2015, Superloop’s purpose is to enable better internet for Australian homes and businesses, by enabling challenger retail brands to take a larger share of the market, leveraging Superloop’s Infrastructure-on-Demand platform.
  
  
Superloop operates in three segments of the market: consumer connectivity, business network and security solutions, and wholesale connectivity, all of which leverage Superloop’s investments in physical infrastructure assets including fibre, subsea cables and fixed wireless, as well as Superloop’s software platforms. Hundreds of thousands of homes and businesses rely on Superloop every day for their connectivity needs.
  
  
Visit www.superloop.com to learn more.
  
  
**Business Unit Overview**
Our Operations unit is the engine room of Superloop - responsible for maintaining and supporting all of our products and internal technical infrastructure to ensure the best possible service to both our customers and our very own business. Our Operations unit is responsible for ensuring that the business has the technical capability and capacity to deliver services to all Superloop customers ranging from Home Broadband to International Wholesale.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
We seek a highly analytical and detail-oriented Business Intelligence Manager to lead the MIS Analysts team in the consumer team, on a one-year fixed-term contract. As a Business Intelligence Manager, you will lead the MIS Analysts team to collect, analyse, and interpret data related to the contact centre operations to provide actionable insights to support data-driven decision-making processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Contact Centre MIS Analytics team.
* Lead the development of data bases and dashboards to ensure timely and accurate decision making.
* Analyse data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of automation processes and recommend enhancements.
* Provide historical data to forecast call volumes and staffing requirements, assisting in workforce planning and resource allocation.
* Prepare clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations for management reviews.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, IT, Business Analytics or a related field.
* MBA in a similar discipline would be an advantage.
* Proven experience in SQL or Python. Proficient in Excel.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills with experience in handling large data sets and providing business insights.
* 7-10 years of relevant work experience in a similar role.
* Strong leadership skills.
* Excellent communication skills & fluency in English.
* Excellent presentation skills.
* Familiarity with contact centre technologies and metrics would be an added advantage.

**On Offer**

* Quarterly Superstar Awards – recognition for those who go above and beyond.
* Milestone Gifts & Birthday Cake.
* Referral Bonus – get rewarded for bringing great talent into the TechHub.
* Fruits & Nuts Mondays and Wednesdays - a healthy start to your week.
* Monthly Engagement Events – cricket matches, festive celebrations, and more.
* Quarterly Team Outings – SuperEats – time to unwind and connect outside work.
* SuperEats – enjoy affordable pre ordered breakfast and lunch options.
* Flexible Work – 3 days in the office, 2 days from home (once confirmed).
* Leadership & Development Training – Grow your skills and confidence.
* Career Excellence Program – build your future in telco and tech, right here at Superloop.
* Employee Assistance Program – we’ve got your wellbeing covered.

*At Superloop, we’re dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be who they are. We actively embrace diversity and celebrate the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of gender, age, faith, ethnicity, nationality, sexuality, neurodiversity, or physical ability. We’re committed to ensuring that our hiring processes are accessible and inclusive for everyone interested in joining Superloop.*
Visit www.superloop.com to learn more

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**About the Job**

**Miwayz Lanka Ltd, a relatively new Taxi & Food Delivery App in Sri Lanka, is looking for an experienced, creative, and results-driven Digital Marketing Manager**
to lead our digital marketing and growth strategy.

This is an opportunity to join Miwayz and play a key role in building the brand, acquiring customers, and driving sustainable growth across Sri Lanka.

**Key Responsibilities**

**As our Digital Marketing Manager**
, you will:

* Develop and execute Miwayz Lanka’s digital marketing and growth strategy.
* Plan, manage, and optimise campaigns across Google, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant digital channels.
* Drive app downloads, customer registrations, first rides/orders, and repeat usage.
* Manage customer acquisition campaigns while optimising Cost per Install (CPI), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and overall marketing ROI.
* Develop targeted campaigns to attract and engage customers, drivers/riders, restaurants, and merchant partners.
* Lead Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) and App Store Optimisation (ASO) initiatives.
* Develop and manage retargeting, remarketing, referral, retention, and customer reactivation campaigns.
* Manage Miwayz social media channels and develop engaging content calendars.
* Create and coordinate localised digital marketing content in
  **English, Sinhala, and Tamil**
  .
* Work closely with designers, content creators, influencers, agencies, and other partners to produce high-performing creative campaigns.
* Conduct A/B testing across advertisements, audiences, promotions, creatives, messaging, and landing pages.
* Use Google Analytics, Firebase, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and other relevant platforms to measure and improve campaign performance.
* Monitor competitors, market trends, and Sri Lankan consumer behaviour.
* Manage digital marketing budgets and provide regular performance reports and recommendations to management.

**Key Performance Areas**

**Success in this position will be measured through:**

* App downloads and registrations
* Cost per Install (CPI)
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* First ride/order conversion
* Monthly Active Users (MAU)
* Customer retention and repeat usage
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Marketing ROI
* Organic traffic and app-store visibility
* Social media growth and engagement

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related discipline.
* Minimum
  **3–5 years of hands-on digital marketing experience**
  .
* Strong practical experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, SEO, ASO, social media marketing, and performance marketing.
* Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics and Firebase.
* Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels, conversion optimisation, retargeting, and retention strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to manage digital marketing budgets and deliver measurable ROI.
* Strong analytical, creative, communication, and project-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Language Requirements**

**Candidates should demonstrate strong communication skills and reading and writing competency in all three languages:**

* English
* Sinhala
* Tamil

The successful candidate should be capable of reviewing, developing, and coordinating customer-facing marketing communications across all three languages to ensure Miwayz effectively serves Sri Lanka’s diverse customer base.

Previous experience in
**ride-hailing, food delivery, e-commerce, mobile applications, fintech, technology startups, or high-growth B2C businesses**
will be a strong advantage.

Experience successfully launching or scaling a consumer mobile application would be particularly valuable.

**Why Join Miwayz?**

**This is more than a traditional social media or digital advertising position.**

**You will have the opportunity to help build the Miwayz brand and digital growth engine from the ground up**
and play an important role in growing a new Taxi & Food Delivery platform in Sri Lanka.

If you are passionate about digital growth, technology, mobile apps, performance marketing, customer acquisition, and building brands, we would like to hear from you.

Interested candidates are invited to apply through
**LinkedIn**
with their CV.

Candidates are encouraged to include examples of successful digital campaigns, app growth projects, portfolios, or measurable marketing results in their application.

**Join Miwayz Lanka Ltd and be part of our journey to transform mobility and delivery services in Sri Lanka.**

title: Engineer - Systems Support - Managed Services (Fixed Term)
description:
**Job Description**

* Provide hands-on troubleshooting and resolution for critical technical issues, dedicating 50% of your time to direct customer problem-solving
* Streamline the escalation process for L2/L3 handoffs, providing detailed solution requirements and maintaining SLA adherence
* Collaborate with Support, Product, and Engineering to identify and resolve recurring issues, and ensure continuous product improvement
* Create and manage internal knowledge bases, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides, contributing to public documentation as needed
* Lead the implementation of the technical support strategy, to scale and deliver world-class client service
* Write and maintain custom scripts to increase system efficiency and lower the human intervention time on any tasks
* Liaise with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution

**Person Specification**

* 2+ years of experience in technical escalation or support engineering.
* Excellent communication skills in the English language
* Experience using IT systems monitoring tools (e.g Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Loki etc
* Experience in scripting (e.g., bash, Perl, Python, Golang)
* Basic knowledge on networking concepts (OSI network layers, TCP/IP)
* Basic knowledge on database management systems (Oracle, MySQL)
* An understanding of cloud technologies ( e.g AWS, Azure, GCP)
* An understanding of containerization technologies and container orchestration tools (e.g docker, kubernetes)
* Certifications related to Cloud Operations, Containerization and System Administration will be an added advantage (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, Redhat, Linux Foundation, VMware, etc.)

title: Quality Assurance Tester
description:
**About The Role**
As a Quality Assurance Tester, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of SaaS products within an agile product environment. You will work closely with development and product teams to design and execute comprehensive testing strategies, identify and manage defects, strengthen test automation, and provide quality-focused insights throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
You will contribute to release readiness, continuous improvement, and the delivery of reliable products that meet customer and business needs.
  
  
**About The Client**
You will be working with an established technology organisation delivering innovative SaaS and enterprise communications solutions. The business operates in a collaborative, product-focused environment and is committed to continuous improvement, quality, and enabling evolving technology needs.
  
  
Ideal Profile
  
  
**Experience**

* Proven experience in software quality assurance, ideally within a product development environment
* Experience with both manual and automated software testing
* Experience with test automation tools and frameworks; Cypress experience is highly desirable
* Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and collaborative product environments

Technical Skills
  
  
  

* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, processes, tools, and testing practices
* Experience developing and executing test plans, test cases, and automated test suites
* Knowledge of functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, E2E, API, UI/UX, production verification, and UAT testing
* Experience with Jira and test management platforms such as TestRail or Zephyr
* Knowledge of Cypress using JavaScript and CI/CD-integrated automation frameworks
* Exposure to API validation using Swagger/OpenAPI and browser developer tools
* Basic SQL and database validation knowledge
* Familiarity with tools such as Gitea, Docker, Cypress Cloud, Confluence, and Miro is advantageous
* Exposure to Cucumber/BDD or Playwright is beneficial

Professional Attributes
  
  
  

* Passionate about software quality and delivering excellent user experiences
* Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and able to think critically and creatively
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Proactive, self-motivated, and accountable
* Comfortable working autonomously while contributing effectively within a team
* Adaptable and collaborative, with a strong commitment to continuous improvement

**Responsibilities**
Quality Assurance & Testing
  
  
  

* Collaborate with product, platform, and development teams to understand requirements and specifications
* Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, E2E, API, UI/UX, production verification, and UAT testing
* Identify, document, track, and support the resolution of software defects
* Conduct thorough regression testing to maintain product stability and reliability
* Provide quality-focused input into product design and functionality
* Represent QA during release-readiness and go/no-go decisions
* Monitor quality metrics and recommend improvements to testing processes

Test Automation
  
  
  

* Design, maintain, and improve automated test suites
* Develop automation using Cypress and support integration with CI/CD pipelines
* Investigate and resolve flaky automated tests
* Analyse CI/CD pipeline failures and improve automation stability and test coverage
* Work with development teams to continuously improve automated testing processes
* Evaluate future adoption of technologies such as Cucumber/BDD and Playwright where appropriate

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
  
  
  

* Communicate testing progress, risks, issues, and quality insights to relevant stakeholders
* Provide recommendations for product enhancements based on QA findings
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes and procedures
* Create and maintain QA documentation, test plans, and knowledge articles using Confluence and Miro
* Participate in relevant quality, compliance, training, audit, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Maintain awareness of applicable quality, environmental, information security, and workplace health and safety standards

How we take care of our team
  
  
💰 Get paid in Australian Dollars
  
  
🏥 Medical insurance from day one for you + spouse (or parents if unmarried)
  
  
🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
  
  
🏡 Home office setup allowance to build your ideal workspace
  
  
🌐 Internet allowance to keep you connected
  
  
💪 Gym & wellness allowance to stay fit and balanced
  
  
🎉 Work hard, play hard – regular team events & engagement activities
  
  
🧠 Diji Assist – Mental health & counseling support when you need it
  
  
📚 We invest in you – reimbursement for industry certifications
  
  
🗣️ Open-door culture – your ideas and feedback always matter
  
  
🌍 Flexible work – home or office, wherever you do your best work
  
  
🏆 Rewards & recognition that actually recognize you
  
  
🥳 Great christmas & financial year-end parties to unwind with your loved ones
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
